The '''Second Siege of Porus Vida''' was a battle of the [[Second Alsakan Conflict]], fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and their respective allies. The siege took place around [[16,100 BBY]] at the planet [[Porus Vida]], and following the confrontation, the Second Alsakan Conflict lasted for another [[15,400 BBY|seven hundred years]].

==Prelude==
The [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] were a fourteen-[[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long series of wars over [[Politics/Legends|political]] control of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies. The latter included the [[Grand Companies]], which were Coruscant-backed [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] conglomerates based along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as [[the Spin]]. The [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EGTW" /> planet<ref name="CSWE Porus Vida">{{CSWECite|III|38|Porus Vida}}</ref> [[Porus Vida]] was situated in the [[Exploitation Region|region]] that was actively controlled by the Grand Companies, but it was also located at the junction of one Alsakani-controlled hyperlane and [[Lesser Lantillian Route/Legends|another hyperspace route]] that was among those either contested or neutral in the conflict.<ref name="EGTW" />

==The siege==
Around [[16,100 BBY]], the Second Siege of Porus Vida was fought at the planet. It was an early battle of the [[Second Alsakan Conflict]], a war that had commenced a [[16,200 BBY|century]] earlier. The Second Siege of Porus Vida marked the second [[Time/Legends|time]] the planet saw fighting as part of the Alsakan Conflicts, following the [[First Siege of Porus Vida|first siege]] that took place over [[16,820 BBY|seven centuries]] earlier during the [[First Alsakan Conflict|First Conflict]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Aftermath==
Following the Second Siege of Porus Vida, the Second Alsakan Conflict lasted for another [[15,400 BBY|seven hundred years]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Second Siege of Porus Vida was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
